name: Tagum

queries.query: Philippines official cadastral parcel map GIS Tagum City cadastral map DENR LMB
queries.result: Found the official Geoportal Philippines viewer and its current layer registry. The registry exposes an LMB agency layer titled Parcel data with layer name denr_parcel_data. Found the official Tagum City Assessor directory and Land Management Bureau records mentioning Tagum tax mapping and Tagum approved subdivision-plan requests. No anonymous parcel feature response was obtained.

queries.query: Tagum City mapa cadastral lote DENR opisyal; Tagum City mapa ng mga lote cadastral opisyal
queries.result: Search results independently surfaced the official Tagum City website, its City Assessor directory, the official Geoportal Philippines viewer, and DENR/LMB cadastral references. No local-language public parcel API or downloadable Tagum parcel geometry was identified.

source.provider: Philippine Land Management Bureau (LMB/DENR) via Geoportal Philippines, with City of Tagum Assessor as local tax-mapping custodian
source.serviceType: Public Geoportal WMS viewer; current registry exposes LMB Parcel data layer, but anonymous feature service access was not verified
safeFieldsRequested: stable native parcel ID if publicly exposed
source.scopeNote: LMB/DENR is the national cadastral custodian evidenced by the Geoportal layer and official land-survey regulation. The official City of Tagum directory identifies the City Assessor's Office, and LMB FOI results identify Tagum tax-mapping and approved-plan records. These establish custodianship/procedure, not open citywide parcel delivery.

verifiedSample.result: No anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was obtained; no GeoJSON sample retained. This is not evidence of citywide parcel absence.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Philippine national LMB/DENR parcel-data layer and Tagum City tax-mapping/cadastral records.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Geoportal HTML/JavaScript and layer-registry JSON were retrieved; the LMB Parcel data layer was identified, but public service schema, CRS, stable IDs, geometry and citywide completeness were not verified.

serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; no independently verified parcel adapter candidate
notes: Research evidence only; not source integration or runtime admission. Exact WUP point preserved in latitude/longitude order with no coordinate shift. No owner, address, titleholder, contact, title, tax/account, personal or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
